description: Lists every scheduled or announced minimum wage change (state, county and city) in a date window, soonest first, with the new rate and source. Use it to plan payroll or warn an employer before a rate rises. Filter by state. Free.

days.description: Window length in days, 1 to 730. Default 365.

from_date.description: Start of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

state.description: Two-letter state code or name. Optional, all states when left out.

name: list_upcoming_minimum_wage_changes
